parts.t: The Ladner Elementary area is close to schools, walking paths, and shops and services. Browse homes for sale below, and contact me with any questions.

The Ladner Elementary area is close to Ladner Village. You'll find older houses on tree-lined streets, updated homes and a few newer builds. Memorial Park, the village shops and cafés, the Ladner Leisure Centre and the library are all nearby, and so are the dyke trails along the river.

If you care about which school your kids would go to, check the address with the Delta School District, because school areas can change. Contact me for current Ladner Elementary homes for sale and recent sales. See all
